summary: Tempest Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a September 14, 2026 exclusive collaboration, option and license agreement with Heibei Senlang Biotechnology covering in vivo CAR-T technology. Tempest receives an exclusive option, exercisable within four months for roughly $447,000, to license worldwide rights excluding Greater China. Post-exercise economics include per-product nomination fees, annual maintenance fees escalating from $10 million to $14 million over three years, a 6% net sales royalty, and sublicense revenue sharing, plus IND or business-development milestones and mutual rights of first negotiation for Greater China. This is an ordinary licensing event, not a special situation.
